newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle turn active late at $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle turn active late at $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet early, active later, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to mostly $1.00 per cwt lower.

Sales confirmed on 8,000 slaughter steers and 8,200 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 37,000 head confirmed including 19,700 head or about 53 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1225 lbs 68.00, few Select with end Choice 1050-1150 lbs 68.00; few mostly Select 1150-1200 lbs 67.00-68.00, pen 1100 lbs Corrientes 64.00; pen Select and Choice 1300 lb Holsteins 62.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1225 lbs 111.00 hot weights, delivered.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 990-1100 lbs 68.00; Select with end Choice 965-1050 lbs 68.00; mixed Commercial to Choice 1100-1300 lb heifers and heiferettes 66.00-67.50. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 111.00 hot weights, delivered.
Confirmed - 16,200 last week - 600 last year - none
Wk to date - 37,000 last week - 82,300 last year - 81,000
